panel.title: Monitor Settings
panel.no_monitors: No DDC/CI monitors found. Make sure ddcutil is installed and DDC/CI is enabled in the monitor's own OSD menu.
panel.arrangement_unsupported: Monitor arrangement requires wlr-randr and a compositor that supports wlr-output-management (Hyprland, Sway, river, ...).
panel.settings_unavailable: DDC/CI settings aren't available for this monitor.

widget.click_to_check: Click to check for DDC/CI monitors

feature_desc.01: Causes a CRT to perform a degauss cycle
feature_desc.02: Indicates that a display user control (other than power) has been used to change and save (or autosave) a new value.
feature_desc.03: Allows display controls to be used as soft keys
feature_desc.04: Restore all factory presets including brightness/contrast, geometry, color, and TV defaults.
feature_desc.05: Restore factory defaults for brightness and contrast
feature_desc.06: Restore factory defaults for geometry adjustments
feature_desc.08: Restore factory defaults for color settings.
feature_desc.0a: Restore factory defaults for TV functions.
feature_desc.0b: Color temperature increment used by feature 0Ch Color Temperature Request
feature_desc.10: Increase/decrease the brightness of the image.
feature_desc.11: Select contrast enhancement algorithm respecting flesh tone region
feature_desc.12: Increase/decrease the contrast of the image.
feature_desc.13: Increase/decrease the specified backlight control value
feature_desc.16: Increase/decrease the luminesence of red pixels
feature_desc.18: Increase/decrease the luminesence of green pixels
feature_desc.1a: Increase/decrease the luminesence of blue pixels
feature_desc.1c: Increase/decrease the focus of the image
feature_desc.1e: Perform autosetup function (H/V position, clock, clock phase, A/D converter, etc.)
feature_desc.1f: Perform color autosetup function (R/G/B gain and offset, A/D setup, etc.)
feature_desc.20: Increasing (decreasing) this value moves the image toward the right (left) of the display.
feature_desc.22: Increase/decrease the width of the image.
feature_desc.24: Increasing (decreasing) this value causes the right and left sides of the image to become more (less) convex.
feature_desc.26: Increasing (decreasing) this value moves the center section of the image toward the right (left) side of the display.
feature_desc.28: Increasing (decreasing) this value shifts the red pixels to the right (left) and the blue pixels left (right) across the image with respect to the green pixels.
feature_desc.29: Increasing (decreasing) this value shifts the magenta pixels to the right (left) and the green pixels left (right) across the image.
feature_desc.2a: Increase/decrease the density of pixels in the image center.
feature_desc.2c: Increasing (decreasing) this value shifts the density of pixels from the left (right) side to the right (left) side of the image.
feature_desc.30: Increasing (decreasing) this value moves the image toward the top (bottom) edge of the display.
feature_desc.32: Increase/decrease the height of the image.
feature_desc.34: Increasing (decreasing) this value will cause the top and bottom edges of the image to become more (less) convex.
feature_desc.36: Increasing (decreasing) this value will move the center section of the image toward the top (bottom) edge of the display.
feature_desc.38: Increasing (decreasing) this value shifts the red pixels up (down) across the image and the blue pixels down (up) with respect to the green pixels.
feature_desc.39: Increasing (decreasing) this value shifts the magenta pixels up (down) and the green pixels down (up) across the image.
feature_desc.3a: Increase/decrease the density of scan lines in the image center.
feature_desc.3c: Increase/decrease the density of scan lines in the image center.
feature_desc.3e: Increase/decrease the sampling clock phase shift
feature_desc.40: Increasing (decreasing) this value shifts the top section of the image to the right (left) with respect to the bottom section.
feature_desc.41: Increasing (decreasing) this value shifts the top section of the image to the right (left) with respect to the bottom section.
feature_desc.42: Increasing (decreasing) this value will increase (decrease) the ratio between the horizontal size at the top and bottom of the image.
feature_desc.43: Increasing (decreasing) this value will increase (decrease) the ratio between the vertical size at the left and right of the image.
feature_desc.44: Increasing (decreasing) this value rotates the image (counter)clockwise around the center point of the screen.
feature_desc.46: Increase/decrease the distance between the left and right sides at the top of the image.
feature_desc.48: Increasing (decreasing) this value moves the top of the image to the right (left).
feature_desc.4a: Increase/decrease the distance between the left and right sides at the bottom of the image.
feature_desc.4c: Increasing (decreasing) this value moves the bottom end of the image to the right (left).
feature_desc.52: Read id of one feature that has changed, 0x00 indicates no more
feature_desc.54: Controls features aimed at preserving display performance
feature_desc.6c: Increase/decrease the black level of red pixels
feature_desc.6e: Increase/decrease the black level of green pixels
feature_desc.70: Increase/decrease the black level of blue pixels
feature_desc.73: Provides the size (number of entries and number of bits/entry) for the Red, Green, and Blue LUT in the display.
feature_desc.74: Writes a single point within the display's LUT, reads a single point from the LUT
feature_desc.75: Load (read) multiple values into (from) the display's LUT
feature_desc.76: Initiates a routine resident in the display
feature_desc.78: Causes a selected 128 byte block of Display Identification Data (EDID or Display ID) to be read
feature_desc.7a: Increase/decrease the distance to the focal plane of the image
feature_desc.7c: Increase/decrease the distance to the zoom function of the projection lens (optics)
feature_desc.7e: Increase/decrease the trapezoid distortion in the image
feature_desc.80: Increase/decrease the keystone distortion in the image.
feature_desc.86: Control the scaling (input vs output) of the display
feature_desc.87: Selects one of a range of algorithms. Increasing (decreasing) the value must increase (decrease) the edge sharpness of image features.
feature_desc.88: Increase (decrease) the velocity modulation of the horizontal scan as a function of the change in luminescence level
feature_desc.8a: Increase/decrease the amplitude of the color difference components of the video signal
feature_desc.8c: Increase/decrease the amplitude of the high frequency components of the video signal
feature_desc.8e: Increase/decrease the ratio between blacks and whites in the image
feature_desc.90: Increase/decrease the wavelength of the color component of the video signal (tint). Applies to the currently active interface.
feature_desc.92: Increase/decrease the black level of the video
feature_desc.95: Top left X pixel of an area of the image
feature_desc.96: Top left Y pixel of an area of the image
feature_desc.97: Bottom right X pixel of an area of the image
feature_desc.98: Bottom right Y pixel of an area of the image
feature_desc.99: Enables the brightness and color within a window to be different from the desktop.
feature_desc.9a: Changes the contrast ratio between the area of the window and the rest of the desktop
feature_desc.9b: Decrease shifts toward magenta, increase shifts toward yellow
feature_desc.9c: Decrease shifts toward green, increase shifts toward red
feature_desc.9d: Decrease shifts toward yellow, increase shifts toward cyan
feature_desc.9e: Decrease shifts toward green, increase shifts toward blue
feature_desc.9f: Decrease shifts toward cyan, increase shifts toward magenta
feature_desc.a0: Decrease shifts toward blue, no effect at the midpoint, increase shifts toward red
feature_desc.a2: Turn on/off an auto setup function
feature_desc.a4: Turn selected window operation on/off, window mask
feature_desc.ac: Horizontal sync signal frequency as determined by the display
feature_desc.ae: Vertical sync signal frequency as determined by the display
feature_desc.b0: Store/restore the user saved values for the current mode.
feature_desc.b4: Indicates timing mode being sent by host
feature_desc.b7: Video mode and status of a DPVL capable monitor
feature_desc.b9: X origin of the monitor in the vertical screen
feature_desc.ba: Y origin of the monitor in the vertical screen
feature_desc.bb: Error counter for the DPVL header
feature_desc.bc: CRC error counter for the DPVL body
feature_desc.bd: Assigned identification number for the monitor
feature_desc.be: Indicates status of the DVI link
feature_desc.c2: Length in bytes of non-volatile storage in the display available for writing a display descriptor, max 256
feature_desc.c3: Reads (writes) a display descriptor from (to) non-volatile storage in the display.
feature_desc.c4: If enabled, the display descriptor is shown when no video is being received.
feature_desc.c6: A 2-byte value used to allow an application to only operate with known products.
feature_desc.c8: Manufacturer id of the controller and a 2-byte manufacturer-specific controller type
feature_desc.ca: Sets and indicates the current operational state of the OSD (and buttons in v2.2)
feature_desc.cd: Controls up to 16 LED (or similar) indicators showing system status
feature_desc.ce: Rows and characters per row of the auxiliary display
feature_desc.cf: Sets the contents of the auxiliary display device
feature_desc.d2: Reads (or writes) an asset tag on the display
feature_desc.d7: Controls an auxiliary power output from a display to a host device
feature_desc.db: Controls aspects of the displayed image (TV applications)
feature_desc.dc: Type of application used on the display
